description: platformAutomerge MUST stay false, the same as bar and for the same reason
(INF-551): a ruleset bypass keys on the actor that PERFORMS the merge, and
GitHub-native auto-merge does not carry it. The pr-approval ruleset arriving
on master grants bypass to truvity-renovate-public as an Integration actor,
so renovate has to merge through its own API call -- as the App the bypass
names -- or its green batch sits waiting for a human approval that the
bypass was supposed to make unnecessary.

packageRules.description: The go directive is OWNED by devbox-update (ci-workflows v2.10.0): it aligns go.mod to the toolchain triple in the same PR as devbox.lock — language minor capped by golangci-lint's build Go, patch = the newest release of that line, never downward. Renovate leaves `go` alone so the three can never disagree (2026-08-23; replaces the bump rule and the minor/strict gates that papered over split ownership).
